title: Pay the acquired critical-kernel size while preserving higher nilpotent layers
statement: For the certified odd-rank contact family b>=5,d>=3,e>=2, exact counting costs(2^kappa+1_(e=1 mod3)*2^d)poly(n+L), kappa<=b-1, with polynomial working space and n=bde original bits.

requires: Acquired complete chain representation and coefficient-verified contact chart
Nonsingular alternating transverse B and nonsingular square matrix M; legal3h<=e+1 quotient support
provides: For the certified odd-rank contact family b>=5,d>=3,e>=2, exact counting costs(2^kappa+1_(e=1 mod3)*2^d)poly(n+L), kappa<=b-1, with polynomial working space and n=bde original bits.
assumptions: Only the residue is required to be contact; higher nilpotent cubic coefficients remain in exact lifts
The omitted projective hyperplane is excluded by invertible M, not by contact vocabulary alone
costs: Stream every affine binary kernel solution and retain its phase
Only the origin recurses; the implemented field leaf scans one coordinate and Gaussian-eliminates the rest
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; F_(2^d) elements and ordinary field/ring exponents are distinct from Boolean ANF masks. Exact signed/zero counts and source-local phase/rank/depth units.
contract.obstruction: A large growing kappa can be exponential. This is not a counter for every radical-free cubic.

body: The exterior map ell->ell wedge C acquires the contact hyperplane. The chart gradient is M*y^[2]+B*y+c. Hensel lifting retains the full higher coefficients, and weighted Gaussian factors retain the quotient phase. No field leaf occurs at depths0/2 modulo3.
